query: SELECT pz.id, pz.label, pz.purpose, ROUND(pz.posX,1) as posX, ROUND(pz.posY,1) as posY, ROUND(pz.width,1) as w, ROUND(pz.height,1) as h, pp.label as partLabel, pp.`key` as partKey FROM product_zones pz LEFT JOIN product_parts pp ON pz.partId = pp.id WHERE pz.productId = 1380006 ORDER BY pp.`key`, pz.id;
